name: ASUS PRIME B550M-K ARGB Motherboard
shortDescription: ASUS PRIME B550M-K ARGB Micro-ATX Motherboard (AMD AM4 Socket / B550 Chipset / PCIe 4.0 x16 / Dual M.2 Slots / 4x SATA 6Gb/s / DDR4 5100MHz OC / Realtek 1Gb LAN / DisplayPort & HDMI / Addressable Gen 2 ARGB Headers /
descriptionHtml:
ASUS PRIME B550M-K ARGB Micro-ATX Motherboard (AMD AM4 Socket / B550 Chipset / PCIe 4.0 x16 / Dual M.2 Slots / 4x SATA 6Gb/s / DDR4 5100MHz OC / Realtek 1Gb LAN / DisplayPort & HDMI / Addressable Gen 2 ARGB Headers / Aura Sync / 1-Year Store Warranty)

Unlock the full potential of your build with the ASUS PRIME B550M-K ARGB Micro-ATX Motherboard, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Store Warranty (ضمان سنة متجر). Designed for AMD Ryzen 5000, 4000 G-Series, and 3000 Series desktop processors, this AM4 socket motherboard boasts PCIe 4.0 speed, dual M.2 slots, high-frequency DDR4 support up to 5100MHz (OC), front panel USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C support, and Addressable Gen 2 ARGB headers with Aura Sync lighting control for complete customization and reliable performance.

Special RGB Headers3 x Addressable Gen 2 ARGB Headers (Aura Sync Compatible)
Form FactorMicro-ATX Form Factor (9.6 inch x 8.7 inch / 24.4 cm x 22.1 cm)
